statements.proposition: This change restores backward compatibility for legacy CompactMap subclasses whose getNewMap returns a reverse-ordered TreeMap without overriding getOrdering.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Impact claim. The diff adds, in legacy mode only, a fallback that treats the SortedMap's comparator as reverse when its class name contains 'reverse' (e.g. java.util.Collections$ReverseComparator), so compact-array sorting would follow reverse order. That plausibly addresses the stated case, but whether compatibility is actually restored was not settled: a base-vs-head probe was compiled but running it in the sandbox was denied by the permission system, so no runtime evidence. Comparators without 'reverse' in their class name (e.g. lambdas, Comparator.reversed()) would not be detected.
